text: Text was hard to read on its background. Use light text on dark backgrounds and near-black text on light backgrounds.
Stacked text layers overlapped. Keep at least 1.2 x the font size between the y positions of two lines, and time them apart.
A draft was almost a copy of an existing design (ui-106-command-palette, 84% alike). Always change backgrounds, animation family, transitions and layout when borrowing ideas.
